title_ja: ナルシシズムと感情の日々の変動：日米比較から見えた共通性と違い
summary_ja: 中国とアメリカの参加者を対象に、日常生活におけるナルシシズムの表れ方と感情のダイナミクスの関係を調査した。その結果、誇大性はポジティブな感情と、脆弱性はネガティブな感情とそれぞれ関連し、これらのパターンは日米の文化圏でおおむね共通していることがわかった。ただし、本研究は自己報告式のデータや特定の2カ国（中国とアメリカ）のサンプルに基づいており、因果関係の断定や他文化への無条件な一般化には限界がある。
why_ja: この知見は、SNS上での自己顕示や日々の気分の波に悩む現代人が、自身のパーソナリティと感情の揺れ動きを客観的に理解し、メンタルヘルスを管理する際に役立ちます。

title_en: When and why are social categories overused relative to individuating information? A Bayesian approach to identifying biases in impression formation processes.
venue: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
abstract_en: When making inferences about others, people often need to integrate multiple types of information, including the person's social categories (e.g., occupation) as well as other "individuating" information (e.g., their behaviors). The current work reexamines this integration process to understand when and why it produces biases involving overreliance on category information. We identify two key challenges in identifying such biases, and develop a novel Bayesian modeling approach to overcome them. As a first step in applying this approach, the current work examined a set of novel predictions based on viewing the continuum model of impression formation in light of this Bayesian approach. Specifically, a series of six studies tested whether occupation categories might be overused in general, or especially in conditions thought to reduce effortful processing (i.e., greater cognitive load or information consistency). Results showed no evidence of category overuse, nor of shifts in this direction, in any of these conditions (though some ambiguity remained about the load manipulation's effectiveness). This provides initial evidence against the idea that intrinsic differences in how these categories are processed or represented will lead to their overuse. A seventh study provided the first direct evidence of a case where categories were overused: when contextual factors (i.e., background goals) made them the category especially relevant, while processing resources were limited. More broadly, the current work developed the theoretical and methodological foundations for identifying category overuse that stems from biased inference processes and demonstrated the power of this approach for understanding when and why such biases occur. title_ja: 他者理解における社会的カテゴリーの過度な依存に関する検証
summary_ja: 他者の印象を形成する際に、社会的カテゴリー情報が過剰に利用される条件やメカニズムをベイズモデルを用いて再検証した。6つの研究では、認知負荷や情報の整合性といった条件においてもカテゴリー情報の過剰使用やその傾向の変化は確認されなかった。ただし、特定の背景ゴールと処理資源の制限が重なった文脈においては、カテゴリーが過剰に使用されることが第7の研究で示されたが、結果の一般化には今後のさらなる検証が必要である。
why_ja: この知見は、職場や面接などの限られた情報と時間の中で、無意識のステレオタイプに基づく偏った判断を避けるための環境デザインに役立ちます。

title_en: Cross-modal social attention differs across emotional categories: Evidence from biological motion and gaze cues
abstract_en: Humans are highly proficient at utilizing various social cues (e.g., biological motion, eye gaze) to guide their attention, even in the detection of stimuli from other modalities, a process known as cross-modal social attention. Here, we investigated whether this fundamental cross-modal social attention could be altered by the emotional information expressed in visual social cues. By presenting emotional (happy and sad) and neutral biological motion (BM) stimuli together with auditory targets in the modified central cueing paradigm, we found that happy BM cues induced a significantly stronger cross-modal attentional effect than neutral and sad ones. Moreover, this cross-modal modulation effect is similarly obtained with attentional effects induced by another type of social signal (i.e., gaze). Importantly, when the emotional information contained in visual social cues (i.e., BM, eye gaze) was disrupted through inversion, this modulation effect vanished, ruling out the potential confound of low-level features. Drift diffusion model (DDM) analysis showed that this effect was primarily associated with shorter non-decision time induced by happy cues (potentially reflecting preparatory attention), rather than with changes in the evidence accumulation rate (potentially reflecting sustained attentional resource allocation). Overall, these findings highlight the flexibility of cross-modal social attention to vary as a function of emotional categories. This cross-modal emotional modulation appears to involve preparatory attentional processing and is observed across perceptually distinct dynamic social signals (i.e., BM, eye gaze), suggesting a similar cognitive mechanism through which emotion perception interacts with cross-modal social attention.
title_ja: 笑顔の生物学的運動が視覚・聴覚を跨ぐ注意を強める
summary_ja: 視覚的な社会的手がかり（生物学的運動や視線）に含まれる感情情報が、クロスモーダルな社会的注意にどう影響するかを調べた。その結果、喜びの感情を示す手がかりは、中立や悲しみのものに比べて、聴覚ターゲットに対する注意効果をより強く引き起こすことがわかった。ただし、この実験は特定の刺激を用いた心理学実験室での検証であり、実世界の多様な文脈やサンプル特性の偏りについては慎重な解釈が求められる。
why_ja: この知見は、対面コミュニケーションやデザインにおいて、ポジティブな感情表現が他者の注意を素早く引きつける仕組みを理解するのに役立ちます。

title_en: The role of pitch in the vocal communication of intentions
abstract_en: Intonation, the variation of pitch in speech, helps listeners understand speakers' communicative intentions. This study examines the role of pitch information at different levels of granularity-spanning specific (discrete contours), more flexible (general contour shape), and general (averaged pitch)-in communicating intentions. We first used a reverse correlation approach to identify people's mental representations of two contrasting intentions - criticism and suggestion - when listening to the word "beer." In a second experiment, listeners rated how much each resulting pattern sounded like criticism and suggestion. Statistical models revealed that listeners rely on the shape of the pitch contour in terms of its spikiness and overall pitch direction, in addition to mean pitch, while precise contour plays a minor role, supporting the relevant role of pitch dynamics as well as the inferential (rather than referential) role of intonation in communicating intentions. Notably, we found distinct groups of listeners who use pitch characteristics in different ways, highlighting both shared understanding (within groups of listeners) and substantial interindividual differences in processing social pragmatic cues. These findings clarify the role of pitch in intention communication, reveal its complexity, and highlight the potential for miscommunication in everyday interactions.
title_ja: 批判か提案か：声のトーンが意図伝達に果たす役割の解明
summary_ja: 本研究は、話し手の声のピッチ（高さや抑揚）のどのような特徴が、聞き手に「批判」や「提案」といった意図を伝える手がかりになっているのかを調べた。実験の結果、聞き手はピッチの細かい変化ではなく、全体の高さや大まかな輪郭、変化の鋭さに依存して意図を推論していることがわかった一方で、ピッチ情報の利用仕方には個人間やグループ間で大きな違いがあることも示された。本研究は実験室内の特定の音声刺激に基づいているため、実際の多様な会話環境や文脈における誤解の生じやすさについては、さらなる検証が必要である。
why_ja: この知見は、ビジネスや日常会話において、言葉の内容だけでなく声のトーンがどのように誤解やすれ違いを生むのかを理解するのに役立ちます。

title_en: Sequence learning as Bayesian filtering.
abstract_en: Here we present a model of sequence learning and recall based on the idea that the function of memory is to maintain an up-to-date representation of the environment that can be used to guide future perception and action. The representation of the environment is considered to be a prior which is combined with information in short-term memory to construct a posterior representation. That posterior representation drives recall and, in turn, is used to update the priors. This prediction-update cycle is a form of Bayesian filter. We apply the model to data from Hebb's (1961) task in which participants learn sequences over repeated presentations in an immediate serial recall task. The model is shown to simulate a wide range of data on the Hebb effect including the ability to learn multiple lists at once, the effect of list spacing, the differential impact of variation in the beginning versus end of lists, learning from response errors, interference between similar lists, and the effects of repetition on forward and backward recall. The model's ability to account for these phenomena follows directly from its basic computational principles. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2026 APA, all rights reserved).
title_ja: 記憶と順序学習のメカニズムを解明：ベイジアンフィルターモデルの応用
summary_ja: 記憶が環境の最新の表現を維持し予測と更新を繰り返す機能であるという前提に基づき、順序学習と再生を説明する新たな計算論モデルを検証した。その結果、本モデルはHebb課題における複数リストの同時学習やリスト間干渉など、幅広い実験データをうまくシミュレートできることがわかった。ただし、本研究はシミュレーションによる理論モデルの提示であり、実際の人間を対象とした場合の特定の個人差や脳内メカニズムの限界についてはさらなる検証が必要である。
why_ja: この知見は、人間の学習効率を高める教育プログラムや、効率的な情報提示を行うユーザーインターフェースの設計に応用できる。

title_en: Genome-wide analysis of social behaviour across social domains, reporters and developmental stages: a meta-regression approach
abstract_en: Abstract Social behaviour is a heritable trait linked to well-being and mental health, yet it varies across social context, including social domains, informants and development, which may shape its underlying genomic architecture. Here, we conducted a genome-wide meta-regression meta-analysis of social behaviour from infancy to early adulthood, studying ~500,000 repeated measures in European-ancestry cohorts ( N = 73,321). We modelled heterogeneity in single-variant associations across social domains (low prosocial behaviour and peer/social difficulties), multiple informants (parents, teachers and self-reports) and ages (2–29 years), identifying 6 associated loci, including variation within CADM2 ( P = 2.51 × 10 −9 ). Single nucleotide polymorphism-based heritability ranged from 2% to 7%, and the genetic architecture comprised 4 factors reflecting differences in either social domains or informants. Polygenic scores ( N = 16,305) accurately predicted contextual variation in independent cohorts, with some cross-ancestry transferability. Context-specific patterns of genetic correlations, particularly when estimating the developmental onset of associations, offer opportunities to disentangle shared trajectories linking social behaviour with later-life and mental health outcomes.
title_ja: 社会的行動の遺伝的基盤：大規模ゲノムメタ解析の結果
summary_ja: 乳幼児期から青年期における社会的行動の多様性とゲノム構造の関係を調べるため、約50万人分の反復測定データを用いたゲノムワイド・メタ回帰メタ解析を実施した。その結果、社会的行動に関連する6つの遺伝子座が特定され、遺伝率は2%から7%の範囲であり、遺伝的アーキテクチャは社会的領域や情報提供者の違いを反映する4つの因子から構成されていることがわかった。ただし、分析対象は主にヨーロッパ系のコホートに限定されており、結果の一般化には注意が必要である。
why_ja: この知見は、社会的行動やメンタルヘルスの個人差を遺伝的・環境的要因の両面から深く理解し、将来的な個別化支援や福祉政策を検討する際の基礎資料として役立つ。

title_en: Observation-related activity in the human motor cortex increases with effector anthropomorphicity
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract_en: Neurons in the motor cortex can be engaged not only in motor execution but also during observation of movements performed by other anthropomorphic agents (i.e., humans or monkeys). However, it is unknown how motor cortical neurons respond during observation of the range of assistive or prosthetic devices controlled by people using intracortical brain–computer interfaces (iBCIs). We recorded single-unit activity in the precentral gyrus while iBCI users viewed grasp-like movements performed by a spectrum of virtual effectors that included human, robotic, and hand-like dot stimuli. We found a relationship between neural modulation and effector anthropomorphicity (i.e., human-likeness) that existed on an ensemble-wide and individual-neuron level, suggesting that human motor cortex activity incrementally increases in response to the visually observed agent’s human-likeness. Both solicited and spontaneous feedback from the participant indicated a relationship between neural activity and subjective assessments of anthropomorphicity, revealing a powerful contribution of context on observation-induced activity in the motor cortex. The activity of the motor cortex remained similar during attempted hand movements while different effectors were being observed, suggesting that intuitive external device control via iBCIs may not be overtly affected by the anthropomorphicity of the effector.
title_ja: 運動野の神経活動は、観察するエージェントの人間に似た度合いに応じて増加する
summary_ja: ブレイン・コンピュータ・インターフェイス（iBCI）のユーザーが人間やロボットなど様々な見た目のエージェントの動きを観察している際、運動野の単一神経活動がどのように応答するかを調べた。その結果、観察対象がより人間らしく（人型に）なるにつれて、集団的および個別の神経細胞レベルで活動が段階的に増加することがわかった。ただし、本研究はiBCIを使用している少数の特定ユーザーを対象とした観察に基づくものであり、一般の健常者における普遍的な脳活動や長期的な適応についてはさらなる検証が必要である。
why_ja: この知見は、義手やロボットアームなどの補助デバイスのデザインや見た目を人間らしく設計することが、ユーザーの脳の自然な反応を引き出す上でどのように影響するかを考える際に役立つ。
